|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, characters 'hit' by Luke may not fire weapons. May deploy Anakin's Lightsaber here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. |errata_history=This is a pre-release (playtest) image of [[Son Of Skywalker (V)]] (version 1 of 3): the PC published it before Virtual Set 24 was officially released (30 December 2024), so it is not the original (Bill, 12 November 2026: pre-release images are Playtest versions; only the image at official release is the original). The current text is [[Son Of Skywalker (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Playtest''' (this page): the pre-release card image (26 December 2024)<ref name="ht-3d2c89e">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1 3d2c89e] “Set 24 New Cards”, 26 December 2024.</ref> prints: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, characters ‘hit’ by Luke may not fire weapons. May deploy Anakin’s Lightsaber here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If a battle just initiated at same site, unless a vehicle here, may target a Dark Jedi here; for remainder of battle, exclude all other characters. Immune to attrition < 4.”<ref name="cj-304ab4f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/304ab4f swccg-card-json commit 304ab4f] “Set 24” (29 December 2024) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''Original''' ([[Son Of Skywalker (V)]]): the card image at official release (29 December 2024, with the PC's Set 24 errata and fixes)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, with the PC's Set 24 errata and fixes.</ref> prints: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, characters ‘hit’ by Luke may not fire weapons. May deploy Anakin’s Lightsaber here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If a battle just initiated at same site, unless a vehicle here, may target a Dark Jedi here; for remainder of battle, exclude all other characters. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' The words of the game text are unchanged. The double space after “characters.” (before “Immune to attrition < 4.”) became a single space. It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.

During battle, characters ‘hit’ by Luke may not fire weapons. May deploy Anakin’s Lightsaber here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If a battle just initiated at same site, unless a vehicle here, may target a Dark Jedi here; for remainder of battle, exclude all other characters. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' The words of the game text are unchanged. The round icon at the right edge of the game-text box (below the two icons) was redrawn. It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.
